output.title: quietpage — Private Journal
output.tagline: Encrypted journaling with no account and no cloud
output.description_short: quietpage encrypts every entry on your device. No account, no cloud, no server ever sees your words. Optional AI reflections run fully on-device.
output.description_long:
**Your thoughts stay on your phone. Full stop.**

quietpage is a journaling app built for people who take privacy seriously. Every entry is encrypted on-device using keys that never leave your phone — not to a server, not to a backup service, not anywhere.

**No account. No email. No cloud.**
Open the app and start writing. There is nothing to sign up for and no company holding your data.

**AI reflections that stay local.**
The optional reflection feature runs a local Core ML model. Your prompts and entries are never transmitted. The thinking happens entirely on your device.

**Plain Markdown export.**
Your journal is yours. Export any time in plain Markdown — readable in any text editor, forever, with no proprietary format to escape.

quietpage reached 1,900 downloads in its first month with no paid marketing, recommended in the r/privacy community. The full security model — including key storage details — is documented publicly on the site.

If a data-breach headline has ever made you think twice about where your most private writing lives, quietpage was built for that moment.
screenshot_order: 1. The blank entry screen — show the minimal writing interface with no login prompt, reinforcing zero-account start
2. The encryption or security badge screen — show the on-device key storage confirmation or lock icon so buyers see the privacy promise immediately
3. The AI reflection prompt screen — show a reflection in progress with a clear 'on-device' label to address the concern that AI means data leaving the phone

faq.q: Does quietpage ever send my entries to a server?
faq.a: Never. Entries are encrypted on your device with keys that never leave your phone. The AI reflection feature runs a local model — nothing is transmitted.

faq.q: Do I need to create an account or give my email?
faq.a: No. Open the app and start writing. No account, no email, no sign-up of any kind.

faq.q: What happens to my journal if I lose my phone?
faq.a: You can export your entries as plain Markdown at any time and back them up however you choose. The security model is documented in full on our site.

faq.q: Is the AI reflection feature safe to use?
faq.a: Yes. It runs entirely on-device using Core ML. Your words never leave your phone, even when you use AI prompts.

faq.q: Can I move my journal to another app later?
faq.a: Yes. Export is always plain Markdown — readable in any text editor with no proprietary format.

output.cta: Write your first entry — no account needed.
